MERN Stack, GitHub API

resumeAnalysis.rawText:
Rakesh Kumar
rakeshchauhan6651@gmail.com   |   +91-9306573459   |   Gurugram, India (Open to Relocate)
GitHub     LinkedIn     Portfolio
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Full-Stack Web Developer specializing in React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB. Experienced in building JWT-authenticated
RESTful services and role-based access control systems, with multiple full-stack web applications deployed and live. Strong DSA
foundation with 165+ problems solved on LeetCode.
EXPERIENCE
Software Development Intern – Codetech IT Solutions
Jan 2026 – Apr 2026
• Engineered an Internal Employee Management System (Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB) supporting 3 user roles, replacing
manual spreadsheet tracking.
• Implemented JWT-based authentication with RBAC across 3 permission tiers (employee, manager, admin), securing
role-restricted API access.
• Designed validated RESTful API endpoints enabling full CRUD operations across employee, department, and role modules.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Frontend: React.js (Hooks, Component Architecture), React Router, Axios, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, Responsive UI
Backend: Node.js, Express.js, REST API Design, JWT Authentication, RBAC, bcrypt
Database: MongoDB, Mongoose (Schema Design & Validation), MySQL
Languages: JavaScript (ES6+), Python, C++, SQL
Tools & Platforms: Git, GitHub, Postman, VS Code, Vercel, Render, npm
Core CS: Data Structures & Algorithms, DBMS, OOP, Operating Systems, Computer Networks
PROJECTS
Task Management System (TaskFlow)
2025
React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, JWT
• Architected a full-stack task platform with component-based React architecture, using Hooks for state management, React
Router for navigation, and Axios for API calls.
• Implemented JWT-based authentication with RBAC, enabling admins to assign tasks across the team while restricting
standard users to their own view.
• Built a real-time analytics dashboard displaying 4 live task-status metrics (total, in progress, completed, to-do) and a 4-tier
priority breakdown (critical, high, medium, low).
• Deployed a fully responsive production build on Vercel.
Live Demo  |  GitHub
Employee Leave Management System (LeaveFlow)
2024
Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, JWT, HTML/CSS/JS
• Developed a leave platform with three role-based dashboards (employee, manager, admin), each with scoped permissions
via JWT/RBAC.
• Automated the leave approval pipeline with real-time status updates across 3 user tiers, eliminating manual tracking.
• Designed RESTful APIs and validated MongoDB schemas with structured request validation and error handling; deployed on
Render.
Live Demo  |  GitHub
Developer Portfolio Health Checker
2026
MERN Stack, GitHub API
• Architected a MERN-stack platform integrating the GitHub API to analyze developer repositories and portfolio sites,
computing hiring-readiness scores across activity, code quality, and profile-completeness dimensions.
• Designed the scoring dashboard and REST API layer, and built an AI-powered feedback engine with recruiter-simulation
logic to help developers identify and close skill gaps.
EDUCATION
Parul University – Vadodara, Gujarat, India
2022 – 2026
B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering
CERTIFICATIONS & ACHIEVEMENTS
SQL (Advanced) – HackerRank  |  C++ Programming – OpenEDG/Cisco  |  Cybersecurity Fundamentals – Udemy  |  Python
Programming – Udemy  |  Full-Stack Web Crash Course (CSS, Bootstrap, JS, PHP) – Udemy
LeetCode: Solved 165+ DSA problems over 100+ active days

resumeAnalysis.rawText:
Rakesh Kumar
rakeshchauhan6651@gmail.com   |   +91-9306573459   |   Gurugram, India (Open to Relocate)
GitHub     LinkedIn     Portfolio
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Full-Stack Web Developer specializing in React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB. Experienced in building JWT-authenticated
RESTful services and role-based access control systems, with multiple full-stack web applications deployed and live. Strong DSA
foundation with 165+ problems solved on LeetCode.
EXPERIENCE
Software Development Intern – Codetech IT Solutions
Jan 2026 – Apr 2026
• Engineered an Internal Employee Management System (Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB) supporting 3 user roles, replacing
manual spreadsheet tracking.
• Implemented JWT-based authentication with RBAC across 3 permission tiers (employee, manager, admin), securing
role-restricted API access.
• Designed validated RESTful API endpoints enabling full CRUD operations across employee, department, and role modules.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Frontend: React.js (Hooks, Component Architecture), React Router, Axios, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, Responsive UI
Backend: Node.js, Express.js, REST API Design, JWT Authentication, RBAC, bcrypt
Database: MongoDB, Mongoose (Schema Design & Validation), MySQL
Languages: JavaScript (ES6+), Python, C++, SQL
Tools & Platforms: Git, GitHub, Postman, VS Code, Vercel, Render, npm
Core CS: Data Structures & Algorithms, DBMS, OOP, Operating Systems, Computer Networks
PROJECTS
Task Management System (TaskFlow)
2025
React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, JWT
• Architected a full-stack task platform with component-based React architecture, using Hooks for state management, React
Router for navigation, and Axios for API calls.
• Implemented JWT-based authentication with RBAC, enabling admins to assign tasks across the team while restricting
standard users to their own view.
• Built a real-time analytics dashboard displaying 4 live task-status metrics (total, in progress, completed, to-do) and a 4-tier
priority breakdown (critical, high, medium, low).
• Deployed a fully responsive production build on Vercel.
Live Demo  |  GitHub
Employee Leave Management System (LeaveFlow)
2024
Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, JWT, HTML/CSS/JS
• Developed a leave platform with three role-based dashboards (employee, manager, admin), each with scoped permissions
via JWT/RBAC.
• Automated the leave approval pipeline with real-time status updates across 3 user tiers, eliminating manual tracking.
• Designed RESTful APIs and validated MongoDB schemas with structured request validation and error handling; deployed on
Render.
Live Demo  |  GitHub
Developer Portfolio Health Checker
2026
MERN Stack, GitHub API
• Architected a MERN-stack platform integrating the GitHub API to analyze developer repositories and portfolio sites,
computing hiring-readiness scores across activity, code quality, and profile-completeness dimensions.
• Designed the scoring dashboard and REST API layer, and built an AI-powered feedback engine with recruiter-simulation
logic to help developers identify and close skill gaps.
EDUCATION
Parul University – Vadodara, Gujarat, India
2022 – 2026
B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering
CERTIFICATIONS & ACHIEVEMENTS
SQL (Advanced) – HackerRank  |  C++ Programming – OpenEDG/Cisco  |  Cybersecurity Fundamentals – Udemy  |  Python
Programming – Udemy  |  Full-Stack Web Crash Course (CSS, Bootstrap, JS, PHP) – Udemy
